title: JetFlow：利用并行树草稿突破推测解码的扩展上限
summary: JetFlow 是一种新的推测解码框架，通过训练一个因果并行草稿头，结合单次前向传播效率和分支级因果条件，突破了推测解码的扩展限制。在 Qwen3 模型上，JetFlow 在 MATH-500 上实现了高达 9.64 倍的加速，在开放式对话任务上实现了 4.58 倍加速，并通过 vLLM 集成在实际负载下进一步降低了延迟。
summary_en: JetFlow is a new speculative decoding framework that breaks the scaling ceiling by training a causal parallel draft head, combining one-forward efficiency with branch-wise causal conditioning. It achieves up to 9.64x speedup on MATH-500 and 4.58x on open-ended conversational workloads with Qwen3 models, with further latency gains via vLLM integration.
